notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello, Hi. Hey. Bonjour! Guten Tag!

Update with some things up now.
⁉️ New Area
A mysterious building has appeared for a possible future mystery. Try and find it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/b7d6ed4775b59799b6855f8e218a551927631add.png"]
💧 New Water
Updated the water shader, used screen position to make it less transparent from where you are looking.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/4c64b76645a32bff8329851afa5198d4eb88f81d.png"]
🔧 Fixes and Adjustments and Additions
Added a sound effect for the sliding automatic door.

Fixed stick markers on the mini-map going under some trees.

Mini-map now shows slightly more distance.

Adjusted the Start menu background graphics some.

Fixed some jagged parts on the ground.
🦆 Duck
Fixed that duck walking under the terrain AND added a worn path under to show it's walked that loop non-stop for many years.  🦆 👻?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/38bf8507ff45fdde57611a88d79a1721549b8e01.png"]

Ok that's it for this update.
